units.source_text: 法事结束之后，便乘此机会继续举办昼夜不断的诵经及忏法，庄严郑重，绝不稍懈。

en.t: After the memorial service ended, they used the occasion to continue holding sutra recitations and repentance rites day and night without pause, carrying them out with solemn care and never relaxing in the slightest.

units.source_text: 然而这种功德终不见效，紫夫人的病总是不见起色。

en.t: Yet these acts of merit ultimately showed no effect, and Lady Murasaki's illness still showed no sign of improvement.

units.source_text: 于是做功德成了日常之事，在各山各寺到处继续举行。

en.t: Thus the performance of meritorious rites became a daily matter, continuing everywhere at temples throughout the mountains.
